mapper.select: SELECT id, hardware_id AS hardwareId, device_type AS deviceType, device_name AS deviceName, device_model AS deviceModel, connection_type AS connectionType, ip_address AS ipAddress, port, baud_rate AS baudRate, api_key AS apiKey, remark, status, config_json AS configJson, store_id AS storeId, version, created_by AS createdBy, create_time AS createdAt, version_desc AS versionDesc FROM hardware_config_version WHERE hardware_id = #{hardwareId} ORDER BY version DESC
